verdict.rationale: Scoped, least-privilege credentials are a fair question for a SaaS work-management product with public APIs, so the axis applies. The pack shows Jira has REST APIs and an official MCP server, but nothing about issuing scoped tokens, OAuth scopes, per-agent credentials, or permission-restricted service accounts. The SAML/SSO mention covers user authentication, not API credential scoping, so this is an applicable axis with no evidence.
